exposure: Preeclampsia status (PE vs. healthy pregnant women)
cohort: 52 pregnant women with preeclampsia and 47 healthy pregnant women
finding: NEP expression (mRNA and protein) was positively correlated with pro-inflammatory markers (IL-6 and TGF-beta) and negatively correlated with the anti-inflammatory cytokine IL-10 in preeclamptic women compared to healthy controls.
